title: Add Glucose Direction and Delta
body:
Version: AAPS 3

Type: Improvement

Add glucose trending direction as an Automation Trigger type

Add Glucose delta value and time time period as an Automation Trigger type

Eg.

Glucose Direction = UP
Delta Period = 40 min
Delta = 1.9 mml or mgdl

This example means Automation will trigger if glucose is rising in 40 mins by 1.9 mml

comments.body:
It already exists (trigger BG difference)
You can select Delta / Short avg. delta / Long avg. delta. and the amount (is equal / is greater than / ...)
Is there an option for direction ?
Ok it takes negative numbers so this will be falling glucose I think
